name: switchsign_create_contract
description: Create a new service agreement and get back a signing URL to send to the client. Use this whenever the user asks to draft, send, or generate a contract/agreement for a client.

client_name.description: The client's legal business name or, if individual, their full name. Used in the contract and audit log.

client_email.description: Email address where the signing reminder and signed copy will be sent.

contract_title.description: Short title for the agreement, e.g. 'Branding Package - Acme Corp'. Appears at the top of the signing page and in email subjects.

markdown_body.description: The full body of the contract in markdown. Should include sections like Project Overview, Deliverables, Fees, Timeline, IP, Liability, Termination, General Provisions. Do NOT include the signature block — SwitchSign adds it automatically.

client_company_name.description: Optional. The client's company name, if signing on behalf of a business. Pre-fills the signing form so the client doesn't re-type it.

client_title.description: Optional. The signer's title/role at the company (e.g. 'Owner', 'CEO'). Pre-fills the signing form.
